audio.music_mood: Upbeat synth puzzle background track with error buzzers and whooshes

content.concept_description: A player tries to clear tangled arrows trapping a mother monkey and baby, repeatedly making wrong moves that trigger error blocks and lower the IQ meter to fail.
content.cultural_reference: Albert Einstein caricature on the IQ meter
content.why_it_works: The IQ comparison and emotional cue of a crying trapped monkey provoke the viewer's ego and urge to solve the maze correctly where the player failed.

visuals.notable_characters: Mother monkey and baby monkey, Einstein avatar
visuals.notable_objects: IQ rating meter, directional arrow tracks, pointer finger, FAIL overlay banner

emotions.emotional_arc: Tension and challenge start -> escalating frustration and failure as moves get blocked

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tapping arrows to slide them out of the maze without hitting obstacles or other blocking arrows.

chapterization.chapter_description: Introduction of the arrow puzzle maze trapping monkeys, with an IQ meter overhead.
Multiple blocked arrow taps turn red, the monkeys start crying, and the IQ meter drops to Dumb.
Final blocked move causes a large FAIL stamp to appear.
Animated game logo and title display for Arrow Puzzle.
